text:
[Council File 26-0005-S196; CD 9]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
HOUSING COMMITTEE REPORT and RESOLUTION relative to removing the property at 1200 West 42nd Street (Case No. 857503), Assessor I.D. No. 5020-011-001, from the Rent Escrow Account Program (REAP).
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the Housing Department (LAHD) report dated October 23, 2026, attached to the Council file, and ADOPT the accompanying RESOLUTION removing the property at 1200 West 42nd Street (Case No. 857503), Assessor I.D. No. 5020-011-001, from the REAP.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the LAHD. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
